description_for_human: Browse, compare, and install 5,705+ OpenClaw AI agent skills across 10 categories.
description_for_model: ClawSkills is the definitive directory for OpenClaw AI agent skills. It provides detailed information about 5,705+ skills across 10 categories including AI & LLMs, Search & Research, Web & Frontend Dev, DevOps & Cloud, Browser & Automation, Productivity & Tasks, Marketing & Sales, Coding Agents & IDEs, Notes & PKM, and Health & Fitness. Each skill includes installation commands, security reviews, ratings, use cases, and FAQs. The site also features comparison tools, tutorials, articles, and a glossary of AI agent terminology.
